localization.instruct_top_txt: No card! No present! No NOTHIN' from his buddy SpongeBob on Valentine's Day, and now Patrick's on the rampage!
localization.instruct_bottom_txt:
Grab the CHOCOLATES and throw them at Patrick. Crash Sandy's chocolate balloon into him for BONUS points.
Press UP to jump and SPACEBAR to throw.
Press LEFT and RIGHT arrow keys to go back and forth in the game.
